notes.title: Planetbase 2 - Dev Update 01
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We've recently announced that we've started work on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3509420/Planetbase_2/]Planetbase 2[/url]. The response has been great, people seem to be as excited about the project as we are, we thank you all for that!

We are now hard at work to make sure the game delivers according to everyone's expectations.

We are actually [i]coding the game from scratch[/i] (as we did for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/858810/Dawn_of_Man/]Dawn of Man[/url]) as the code for Planetbase 1 is very old and it's just better to start over.

We've added a ton of stuff so far, but these are some of the highlights:


[h2]New Astronaut models[/h2]

We've updated the Astronauts with a more modern look and with more real proportions, a bit more like the characters in Dawn of Man.
Models can be [i]tinted[/i] with various colors for the different [i]specializations[/i]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10221286/923ff27db3f0a15fa5f607a925f4886a5cdc9c41.png[/img]
We've posted more details about this on [url=https://x.com/madrugaworks]social media[/url] if you are interested: 
[url=https://x.com/madrugaworks/status/1920066429254054209]Video[/url] - [url=https://x.com/madrugaworks/status/1918202661544829430]Concept [/url]- [url=https://x.com/madrugaworks/status/1925155543800336653]PB1 Comparison[/url].


[h2]Vehicles[/h2]

We have various [b]vehicles [/b]in the game. They allow colonists to [i]carry more resources[/i] and [i]reach locations[/i] further from the base.
You can also build [b]roads[/b], which make vehicles a lot [b]faster[/b].

Colonists automatically pick up vehicles when needed, but you can also manually tell them to do so, and tell them where to drive the vehicle.
We are also working on specialized mining and tanker vehicles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10221286/b6d9dc449426ed2e7d405d2654fe85a7d24f686f.png[/img]
More details:
[url=https://x.com/madrugaworks/status/1928406174539399670]Video [/url] - [url=https://x.com/madrugaworks/status/1927332585681633692]High Poly[/url] - [url=https://x.com/madrugaworks/status/1912403672119529748]Pathfinding[/url]


[h2]Nuclear Power[/h2]

We have the complete nuclear power mechanics in the game.
- There is a [b]Nuclear Reactor[/b] structure, that needs to be fed [b]Nuclear Fuel[/b].
- They need to be monitored from the [b]Nuclear Console[/b] in the [b]Control Center[/b] (like Telescopes in PB1).
- They produce [b]Nuclear Waste[/b], that has to be taken to the [b]Nuclear Dump[/b].
- The [b]Landing Ship[/b] will have a nuclear reactor inside, which will provide initial power for the colony.
- We will still have [b]Solar Panels[/b] and [b]Wind Turbines[/b], nuclear power will be an alternative that will work well in certain situations.

See the [b]Nuclear Reactor[/b] (available in 3 sizes) and [b]Nuclear Dump[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10221286/fd691335646f96c3df5873a982ae917706e94ddd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10221286/2f051557f4c4a94cd3a05bdd3a66856adea76cdc.png[/img]


[h2]Conclusion[/h2]

We are also working on other stuff, like the [b]Tech Tree[/b], [b]Work Areas[/b], [b]Mining [/b]and even [b]Toilets[/b]!

We intend to post updates every 2-3 months here, but if you want to stay more up to date with the development you can follow us on [url=https://x.com/madrugaworks]X[/url] or [url=https://madrugaworks.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url], we post several times a week there.

Let us know what you think!

Martiño.

notes.title: Planetbase 2 Announcement
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We can now announce that we've started work on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3509420/Planetbase_2/]Planetbase 2[/url]. You can wishlist it if you are interested. We will be publishing a devlog with regular updates on [url=x.com/madrugaworks]X[/url] and [url=madrugaworks.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url].

It's now been more than [b]10 years[/b] since we've started working on Planetbase. It was our first title, and at the time only had the resources to develop the game for about 1 year, so we came up with a minimal design and we implemented it as quickly as we could.

The game was a massive success for us, allowed us to fund our studio, and make a living out of creating games, which was incredible. We thank you all for that!

Now the time has come to go back to our origins and [b]revisit the Planetbase idea[/b]. We now have the time and resources to expand a concept that we always thought had a [b]lot more potential[/b].

[previewyoutube=eL_VGHLvpzg;full][/previewyoutube]
We've started work on this about 6 months ago, and we are still very much working out the exact design for the game, but these are the core ideas are focusing on:

[h3]Real worlds[/h3]
In Planetbase, the planets were inspired by real worlds of the solar system, but we stopped short of calling them by their names.
Now we want to add a more [i]realistic[/i] twist (if you can call the colonization of the Solar System realistic) and allow the player to colonize real worlds. 
We are initially working on [b]Mars[/b], but other worlds worlds we have in mind are [i]The Moon[/i], [i]Europa [/i]or [i]Titan[/i].

[h3]Tech Tree[/h3]
In Planetbase you could acquire some techs, but now we are adding a proper tech tree like in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/858810/Dawn_of_Man/]Dawn of Man[/url]. Where it makes sense you will be able to research new technologies, and if we are talking about things that couldn't be researched in an off planet-colony you will be able to buy the right patents to use them.

[h3]Vehicles[/h3]
Off world colonization won't be possible without using vehicles. We are working on adding [b]rovers[/b], [b]mining vehicles[/b] or [b]propellant tankers[/b]. These will be instrumental to increase the [b]efficiency [/b]of your base.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10221286/bc6a805511fe98a0a946acc3b0de0c43f91dfe40.png[/img]

[h3]Complex production chains[/h3]
We want to expand on the simple ideas we had in Planetbase for resource gathering and manufacturing, allowing the player to mine in-situ resources and go in more detail about what would be required to create a self sustaining off-world manufacturing industry.

[h3]New power and water sources[/h3]
The power/water mechanics in PB1 were pretty simple, we now want to add more complex power and water mechanics. Things like actively mining and [b]melting ice[/b] to produce water, building an maintain [b]nuclear reactors[/b], survey the planet surface searching for the right area to place a [b]geothermal[/b] plant and more....

[h3]Separate bases[/h3]
This is an idea we always had in mind, we really need to think through how the player will be able to control this from the gameplay point of view, but we want to enable construction of separate bases and power grids.

[h3]RTS features[/h3]
All the RTS style features like multi-selection and direct commands from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/858810/Dawn_of_Man/]Dawn of Man[/url] will be making a comeback.

[h3]Devlog[/h3]
This time around we've decided to announce the game much earlier, instead of working in the dark for years in order to gather feedback and engage with the community. We will be publishing a devlog with regular updates on [url=x.com/madrugaworks]X[/url] and [url=madrugaworks.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url].

Thank you everyone for joining us in this amazing journey!
Martiño.

notes.title: Version 1.4.0 released
notes.content:
Hello all,

Finally, after releasing our new game, we have some time in our hands and are able to release this new update for [b]Planetbase [/b].

[h2]Intro[/h2]
Planetbase was initially developed in 2015, using Unity 5, this update brings is up to date to Unity 2022.3, which is the latest stable. This brings a ton of compatibility and graphics upgrades.
This was an arduous task, as the old graphics pipeline no longer exists, so we had to redo some of the graphics code and update the assets.

[h2]Main Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Game now uses [b]Unity 2022.3[/b], which is the latest stable  (up from 5.0.4). 
This provides improved compatibility for modern systems, people with dual screen setups and more.
[*]The game now uses [b]Physically Based Rendering[/b], this is a better lighting model compared to the old Blinn-Phong system that 1.3.8 used. Terrains and structures look glossier and nicer, more in line with how Dawn of Man looks.
[/list]

[h2]Changelist[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Now using the Deferred rendering instead of Legacy Deferred.[/b]
Legacy Deferred renderer is no longe available, this changes the appearence of the game slightly, but we've tweaked the materials in the game to match the original renderer as much as possible.

[*][b]Terrain, structures and objects now use PBR lighting.[/b]
They look nicer and have better specular reflections.

[*][b]Increased detail draw distance and terrain LOD quality across the board.[/b]
Terrain now looks better and you see more objects at a distance.

[*][b]Redone all flares using ProFlares[/b]. 
Old school Unity flares don't work properly anymore, so had to recreate them. This includes the Suns in title screen and game as well as Landing Pad flares.
Results are not identical, but new flares look arguably better.

[*][b]Reworked fog. [/b]
Old school fog doesn't work anymore. This now uses a fullscreen effect, results are virtually identical to before for terrain, and better for Buildings and Characters, as they pick the proper horizon color.

[*][b] Fixed issue with icons when playing at 4K resolutions.[/b]
Icons now upscale properly in resolutions higher than 1920x1080.

[*][b]Tweaked lights and environment parameters in all planets.[/b]
This is to make sure the planets retain the same vibe as before, as the new lighting system produces different results.

[*][b]Increased shadow distance and quality overall.[/b]
Shadow maps now use higher res textures and render further.

[*][b]Removed support for GUI Layout.[/b]
This saves per frame memory allocations.

[*][b]Removed specific shaders for Low quality setting.[/b]
It now uses the same shaders as the rest of the quality settings.

[*]The game now detects high end systems and defaults quality to "High"

[*]Updated to latest SteamWorks API.

[*]Tweaks to loading screens.
[/list]

Let us know what you think. Do you light the new lighting? This is update solve or cause any issues for you?

Thank you everyone for your support, and for making this possible!

Martiño.

notes.title: Version 1.3.7 released
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

This is a small maintenance update that adds a couple of new features and fixes.

[h1]Workshop Uploader[/h1]
We've ported this from Dawn of Man. This is an in-game tool that allows you to upload workshop items, instead of having to use the old batch file.
This simplifies the process, as it features a graphical interface instead of having to modify a text file, and automatically tags your item as [i]Translation[/i], [i]Challenge[/i] or [i]Campaign[/i], which makes it immediately visible using the filters in the workshop.
There is a small guide on how to use it [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2053037162]here[/url] although it should be quite self explanatory.

[h1]Other Fixes[/h1][list][*]You can now pin the game to the taskbar and launch it from there, and it will work properly. Before this would have disabled steam features.
[*]Better handling of some cases when games can't saved, instead of crashing the game will show a toast with an error message.
[*]Fixed a couple of rare crashes.[/list]

We want to thank everyone that downloaded and played our little game! This was the project that allowed us to start our studio and continue making games, we hope you all enjoyed it!

Martiño.

notes.title: Version 1.3.5 released
notes.content:
Small maintenance update:

[h1]Changelog[/h1]

1.3.5
- Now temp save files have unique names to prevent rare sharing violation crashes.

1.3.4
- Fixed crash saving games introduced in 1.3.3

1.3.3
- Fixed text in tutorial, that indicated that main menu was at the top of the screen, when in fact it has moved to the bottom in the latest version.
- Fixed typo in Cabin tooltip.
- Temp files for profile, settings and savegames, are now created in the same folder as the final file to reduce the likelihood of corruption.

1.3.2
- Printed message when game can not write log.txt file

1.3.1
- Fixed rare crash while downloading the Dawn of Man announcement image
- Preventing broken challenges from crashing the challenges screen
- Fixed various glitches when changing resolution on Mac

notes.title: Version 1.3.0 released
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10221286/b78e50f75ed69218d8dbd283b3aa45699ecb1fcf.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

We've been playing with the UI layout quite a bit in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/858810/Dawn_of_Man/]Dawn of Man[/url] and wanted to move some of those changes over to Planetbase.

Additionally, we wanted to address some other common requests, like production limits for each bot type, easier access to alerts and clearer display of resources.

Mac computers are deprecating 32 bit apps soon, and we also wanted to address that.

[h1]Feature list[/h1]

* Bioplastic, Metal and Semiconductor resource counts now reflect the free amounts by default (not the total amounts).

* New improved UI layout[list]
	[*] Main menu is now at the center bottom of the screen
	[*] General panel and resources panel are now always visible
	[*] Context menu is displayed on top of selection panel
	[*] Removed build menu, build external and build internal are now top level menus
	[*] Moved tutorial instructions to the upper part of the screen
[/list]

* Added production limits for the different types of bots

* Streamlined charts window[list]
	[*] Only important charts are shown by default
	[*] There is a "more" button that shows all charts
[/list]

* Added keyboard shortcuts for alert modes

* MAC build is now 64 bit, as 32 bit apps are going to be deprecated soon

* Fixed a bug that could make the game display a black screen on Windows at startup


Any feedback let us know!

notes.title: Planetbase 1.2.3 released
notes.content:
This is a version focused mostly on adding more help and hints, trying to make life easier for new players. There are also a couple of additional extras.

The full changelog is:

[b]MUSIC[/b]
- New (and final) music track.

[b]UI[/b]
- Improved challenge select screen, you can now see descriptions before launching challenge.

[b]HELP[/b]
- Added new Metagame section in help menu, explaining some of the core's game mechanics in more detail.
- Addes status icons for colonists when their stats are below optimal.
- Added food, power and repair hints in game when low on food, power or spares.
- Making sure we don't show hints in challenges.
- Added warning for low storage space.
- Added better text in game over screen, prompting the user to play tutorial or check metagame section.
- Incresed width of area where tips get drawn in loading screen, to avoid them occupying 3 lines.

notes.title: Version 1.2.2 released
notes.content:
[img]http://planetbase.madrugaworks.com/images/banner122.png[/img]

New campaign, more workshop integration and much more, see full list of changes:

[b]CHALLENGES[/b]
- New "Freeman Chronicles" mini campaign with 3 new challenges.
- Rearranged challenge select screen, now challenges are grouped by campaign.
- In Mining Station Alpha challenge, traders come more frequently, and there is an extra Driller Bot.
- In Starport Atlantis challenge, you now get an extra Carrier Bot and Biologist at the start, but no Workers. Also you get no food traders anymore.
- In Frozen cage challenge, you only need to survive for 15 days now.
- Rocks in the Dark Moon challenge now have the same color as the surface.
- Fixed issue when loading strings from campaign challenges.
- Fixed welfare objective in challenges.

[b]GENERAL[/b]
- New music track.
- Added vsync option to settings menu.
- Fixed issue with resources in storage sometimes not being selectable.

[b]WORKSHOP INTEGRATION[/b]
- New buttons in the settings and challenges screens that open the workshop with the right filters, in order to download new languages or challenges.
- Languages and challenges now refresh automatically when subscribing to new items from the workshop without restarting the game.

[b]CHALLENGE CREATION[/b]
* New things that can be done in challenges:
   - Specify a restricted set of specializations that come in colonist ships.
   - Specify the size of a building to be built as an objective in a challenge.
   - Specify a particular type of colonist or bot to build as objective.
   - Prevent workers from mining.
   - Change the frequency of trading ships.
   - Change the color of the planet's rocks.
   - Change the Sun, Environment Map and Backdrops.

In this version we've added some new models, the ability to see completed achievements within the game and made some improvements to challenges.

- 4 new challange related achievements.
- New music track.
- Reworked title screen a bit, moved credits to a smaller button, and added switch planet and worshop buttons.
- Pyramid now requires Signpost first.
- When buying vegetables, vitromeat or meals from traders you now get a random subtype.

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 released
notes.content:
[img]http://planetbase.madrugaworks.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/storm_planet_banner.png[/img]

Version 1.1 is a major update for Planetbase, including a new planet, new structures, techs disasters and a lot more, adding more hours of gameplay and taking the game to a whole new level.

These are the details:

[h1]New class S planet[/h1]
The most difficult planet in the game, it requires 12 milestones to unlock and in it you will have to deal with constant thunderstorms, erratic energy generation and limited space, offering a proper challenge for the more experienced players.

[h1]New structures[/h1]
- [b]Lightning Rod.[/b] Exterior structure that protects from lightning and at the same time can harvest its energy and store in a Power Collector.
- [b]Pyramid.[/b] Intermediate prestige structure, that is now required before you build the Monolith.

[h1]New techs[/h1]
- [b]Mega Collector Patent.[/b] Tech that enables the construction of Very large Power Collectors.
- [b]Super Extractor Patent.[/b] Tech that enables the construction of Large Water Extractors.

[h1]New disasters[/h1]
- [b]Blizzard.[/b] Disaster for the Frozen planet (instead of Meteors and Solar Flares).
- [b]Thunderstorm.[/b] Disaster for the Storm planet.

[h1]New animations[/h1]
- More idle animations for colonists
- New animation for drinking on the floor
- New tired animations for colonists

[h1]New music[/h1]

notes.title: Version 1.0.11 released
notes.content:
Small update before the larger 1.1 which will be hopefully ready soon.

[b]UI[/b]
- The UI now reflects the number of actually available construction materials in several ways (the number of resources that are not tied in a build site or component).
[list]
[*] In the stats panel, the number of usable resources will be displayed in brackets next to the total amount (also in a tooltip).
[*] In the resources panel, if some of the resources are tied, an icon will be displayed next to the resource: Yellow arrow/Orange arrow/Red cross (depending on whether some/half/all of the resources are unusable)
[*] In the resources panel, you can hover over a resource and tooltip indicating the exact number of usable resources will appear.
[/list]

This feature had been requested many times, and it took us a while to do it because we wanted to implement it in a way that wasn't confusing or overwhelming for the player.
Note that this only applies to Metal, Bioplastic and Semiconductors, as they are the only resources used as construction materials, and where this information makes sense.

[b]MAC[/b]
- Using proper fullscreen mode, so the full resolution is available on retina displays. 

[b]FIXES[/b]
- Fix for components in the control center not showing the priority icon
- Fix for bug that could allow players to "steal" from traders if holding the trade button
- Fix for tutorial being broken if you dismissed the windows pressing escape
- Fixed a couple of rare crashes.

[b]UPDATE 1.0.11b[/b]

Quickfix for game startup issues on mac.

notes.title: Version 1.0.10 released
notes.content:
This version adds Mac support, as well as a bunch of AI and gameplay fixes.

The full list of changes is:

[b]NEW PLATFORM[/b]
- The game is now available on Mac

[b]AI[/b]
- AI will now will prioritize the storage of resources with low condition
- Engineers will try really hard to build structure connections before going back to base
- AI will wait for longer to go back inside the base for food, drink or sleep, this should prevent them from going out of the airlock and coming back in straight away

[b]GAMEPLAY[/b]
- The meal maker will now make a salad out of any three different vegetables
- Simplified recipe list in Meal Maker help
- Reduced power consumption of Base Pad to 0.25 KW

[b]SHORTCUTS[/b]
- Backspace now does the same as Delete (this is mainly for Mac)
- Toggle panels shortcut his now the T key (it was Alt before)

[b]LOCALIZATION[/b]
- When you select a language, a toast will appear if it has any missing strings.

[b]FIXES[/b]
- Fixed issue where meteors were the same frequency regardless of game speed
- Fixed mouse offset issues if resolution didn't match screen's aspect ratio
- Fixed colonists sometimes getting stuck in a loop when there are no tables available to eat
- Fixed issue where you would get paid even if visitors had died in the colony
- Fixed repairable structures sometimes getting stuck in a weird state
- Resolution is now saved in settings file instead on relying on windows to remember it
- Stability fixes

[b]UPDATE version 1.0.10b released[/b]
- This fixes issue introduced in 1.0.10, where pressing the T key when a merchant had landed wouldn't toggle the resources panel.

[b]UPDATE version 1.0.10c released[/b]
- Fixed issue with AI where colonists could get stuck in a loop at the airlock when going for Meals in the exterior of the base.
- Fixed broken text in spanish tutorial.

notes.title: Version 1.0.7 released
notes.content:
The focus of this version is on gameplay balance improvements: we are adding the new Medical Cabinet component, changing the behavior of Cabins so they are more useful, and tweaking the difficulty of the Frozen and Gas Giant Moon planets.

[b]NEW CONTENT[/b]
- Added Medical Cabinet component to the Sick Bay: Medical Supplies can be stored here to avoid Medics having to go to the nearest storage
- New model for Control Center

[b]GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/b]
- Colonists no longer own beds in the Cabins, now any colonist can sleep in any bed
- Wind is now a bit more stable, it tends to stay away from the extremes, which should make the frozen planet a bit easier
- Increased frequency of Solar Flares in moon planet, which should make it a bit harder
- Increased Monolith cost to 40 Metal and 10 Bioplastic (from 20 and 5), and Prestige to 60 (from 30)
- Reduced Signpost prestige from to 5 (from 10)

[b]MISC FIXES[/b]
- Fixed memory leak 
- Preventing the game from overusing the GPU when minimized
- Text highlighting for non English languages works a lot better now
- Guns inside the Armory can now be traded (and Medical Supplies in the Medical Cabinet too).
- New "durable" and "surveyed" status icons 
- Improved the appearance of non-Latin text overall
- Fix for resolution settings stuck to 0x0 sometimes
- Better error handing for when the game can't save files
- Many bug fixes

notes.title: Version 1.0.6 released
notes.content:
This update is mostly about improved pathfinding, this should make the behaviour of colonists on large or complicated beases a lot better.

The full list:

[b]AI TWEAKS[/b]

- Optimized pathfinding to allow 3 times as many nodes as before, this will massively reduce the chances of colonists not finding a path
- Colonists and bots will now exit the base through the best possible airlock for their destination
- If a colonist or bot can't find a path to the destination it will at least try to get closer instead of wandering in the wilderness
- The game can now cope with donut shaped bases with airlocks inside and outside the donut
- The game can now cope with isolated resources or structures
- When a colonist is very hungry or thirsty, they will go for the nearest Meal or Fountain regardless of it being targeted by another colonist

[b]GAMEPLAY TWEAKS[/b]
- Setting a building to high priority now also affects the resources that get taken there, not just the frequency of work.
- Increased structure limit to 250 and population limit to 600

[b]MISC[/b]
- When a colonist gets Malnutrition for the first time, a hint explaining the condition will appear

[b]FIXES[/b]
- Increased Solar Flare visual intensity on 3rd planet
- Disabling alert if the last control center is recycled
- Preventing mines from being placed in strange places
- Limiting render frame rate when app is out of focus
- Fixed workaround for structure limit
- When looking for a resource to store or trade, colonists and bots will now pick the closest resource to them
- When healing, medics will pick the closest target to them
- Misc small fixes
- Stability fixes

notes.title: Version 1.0.5 Released
notes.content:
In this version we are overhauling the trading system, tweaking AI, improving the UI and adding support for third party translations.

[b]NEW FEATURE[/b]
- Now the game can load third party translations from Documents/Planetbase/Strings

[b]GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/b]
- Trading Ships now have a maximum cargo capacity, and can't trade if they are over it (60 for small ships, 120 for the large ones)
- You can now set buildings in construction as high priority to make the AI take care of them first
- Wind Turbines now decay a bit slower (55 min now, from 45 min before)

[b]AI TWEAKS[/b]
- Reduced the amount of people taking resources to traders
- Engineers and Constructor Bots are now very likely to build connections after building structures
- Biologists will tend to maintain more damaged Vegetable Pads first

[b]UI IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
- Certain panels (Landing Permissions, Security Controls...) are now accessible from the info panel after selecting certain structures
- Stats window now displays how many guards are armed

[b]FIXES[/b]
- If you have a Starport and delete the Landing Pad, you can still build more Starports and access the Landing Permissions
- Fixed engineers getting confused when an unconnected interior structure got damaged
- Fixed pathing issues due to rocks blocking areas near airlocks
- Fixed colonists taking guns to the armory even if it was full
- Fixed issue with preventing colonists from arriving to the base when loading a game with a solar flare in progress in planet1on 1.0.4
- Stability fixes

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 released
notes.content:
Over the last few days we've been listening carefully to the community and we've finally had the chance to implement some balancing and AI tweaks based on user feedback.

This is the full list:


[b]GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/b]

- Removing solar flares from desert planet as this was making the game too hard too early, it also makes planets more different.
- Guards now have 20% armor (they were always meant to, this was a bug).
- Colonists and Bots inside the Mine are now unaffected by solar flares or sandstorms
- If you are low on Food/Spares/Medical Supplies, there is a high chance you will get a merchant bringing these goods
- You can now delete resources laying on the ground


[b]AI TWEAKS[/b]

- AI will now prefer to repair very damaged buildings over less damaged ones (as long as they are not much further).
- Setting a structure to high priority now has a more dramatic effect on AI behavior: They will prefer to work there before carrying stuff around or relaxing.
- Better AI behavior when base is on alert: Anyone walking outside will go inside immediately, and no one will ever go outside from the inside.


[b]UI IMPROVEMENTS[/b]

- Highlighting keyboard shortcuts in a more obvious way.
- Removed "Meteor has been destroyed" notification.


[b]FIXES[/b]

- Doing basic checks on savegames to ensure they have not been tampered with
- Fixed "Police State" achievement
- Fix for issues with navigation when building to the edge of the map
- Fix for corridors sometimes getting locked by accident.
- Fix for massive storage sometimes having graphic glitches on the doors.
- Fix for colonists getting stuck if there was an unbuilt component placed in an isolated module.
- Fix for resources sometimes getting stuck after recycling buildings.
- Fix for telescope animation bug
- Lowering alert volume sound
- Stability fixes


We will keep on improving the AI over the next few weeks, especially focusing on trading and pathing issues.

- Fix for massive storage sometimes having graphic glitches on the doors.
- Fix for colonists getting stuck if there was an unbuilt component placed in an isolated module.
- Fix for resources sometimes getting stuck after recycling buildings.
- Fix for telescope animation bug
- Lowering alert volume sound
- Stability fixes


We will keep on improving the AI over the next few weeks, especially focusing on trading and pathing issues.
